content.summary: Work items generated from git review UI commit plan

work_items.title: Enrich File.status() to separate staged vs unstaged changes
acceptance_criteria: File.Info schema has optional stage field (staged/unstaged/untracked)
File.status() runs git diff --cached and git diff separately
Duplicate files appear as two entries with distinct stage values
SDK regenerated and typecheck passes

work_items.title: Scaffold the /changes route and command registration
acceptance_criteria: ChangesRoute type added to Route union
App renders Changes component for changes route
/changes slash command registered and navigates correctly
Escape navigates back to returnTo route
Typecheck passes

work_items.title: Build the file list sidebar for the Changes route
acceptance_criteria: FileList component fetches and displays changed files
Files grouped by Staged/Unstaged/Untracked sections
Keyboard navigation (up/down/enter) and visual selection highlight
Selected file signal lifted to parent
Typecheck passes

work_items.title: Build the diff viewing pane for the selected file
acceptance_criteria: DiffPane renders diff for selected file using <diff> element
Split/unified auto-detection based on width and config
Handles added, deleted, modified, and binary files
Scrollable for large diffs
Typecheck passes

work_items.title: Add footer with keybind hints and summary stats
acceptance_criteria: Footer shows file count and total +/- stats
Keybind hints displayed
Reactive to file list data changes
Typecheck passes

work_items.title: Add line commenting and submit-to-prompt
acceptance_criteria: User can add comments via 'c' key with text input
Comments stored in local store with file/line/text
Comment count shown in footer
Shift+S formats and injects comments into prompt via route navigation
Typecheck passes

data.dependency_graph: WI-01 and WI-02 are independent (parallel). WI-03 depends on WI-02. WI-04 depends on WI-02+WI-03. WI-05 depends on WI-03. WI-06 depends on WI-04.
data.suggested_build_order: Build WI-01 and WI-02 in parallel first. Then WI-03. Then WI-04 and WI-05 in parallel. Finally WI-06.
